slides.headline: WHERE COMPLETE FILES STILL FAIL
slides.never: Assemble every document correctly but never cross-check them against each other. Seven correct documents that disagree on dates read worse than five that agree.
slides.instead: Audit the set as a whole — dates, amounts, addresses, purpose — so the file tells one story from first page to last.
